patterns: Avengers: Doomsday owns the day: Korea drone show with Iron Man morphing into Doctor Doom 8.68M, the Thor to Steve Mjölnir transition 792k, a Doctor Doom parade in Japan 413k

Celebrity Halloween costumes are the format of the weekend: Macaulay Culkin's thousand-yard stare 6.88M, RDJ and Pedro Pascal as Mr. Fantastic and Doctor Doom 2.62M (plus 161k and 56k on FilmUpdates), Bugonia couples costume 895k, J.Lo as Barbarella 621k, Tenenbaums 523k
Talk-show anecdotes travel far: Hayden Christensen's apologetic burglar 2.88M, Paul Bettany's 10 burst blood vessels 2.88M, Jennifer Lawrence on Mystique prosthetics 493k
SNL monologue clip: Inde Navarrette's jab at Shane Gillis 5.09M, the biggest non-Marvel post
Critic fights drive replies: Taika Waititi calling critics 'sad lost souls' 2.70M with 680 replies on only 9.1k likes, the highest reply ratio on the board
Games keep crossing over: GTA 6 release month 1.45M, Fortnite free V-Bucks token 876k, One Piece teaser 358k, Tony Tony Chopper 211k, Coco's Dante 191k, Pikmin short 165k
Box office: You Can See Everything beat Clayface for #1 over Halloween weekend 71.7k; Clayface at about $83M worldwide on a $44M budget 102k
ATRightMovies' question and bare-image posts pull 40 to 91 replies on 12k to 20k views; CinemaTweets1's best was the cryptic caption 'Winner of the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor' at 68.5k
narrative_synthesis: Avengers: Doomsday and Halloween ran the watchlist. Marvel's Korea drone show morphing Iron Man into Doctor Doom hit 8.68M, and celebrity costumes stacked up behind it, led by Macaulay Culkin's thousand-yard stare at 6.88M and RDJ with Pedro Pascal as Mr. Fantastic and Doom at 2.62M. Talk-show anecdotes (Christensen, Bettany) and Taika Waititi's swipe at critics each cleared 2.7M.
